beats.detail: Only after seeing the lowered opponent sword, the keeper slowly withdraws his tip and lowers his blade; challenger exhales, shoulders easing, no foot movement.

beats.label: 风回庭院
beats.detail: In calm stillness both swords stay lowered, faces soften and robes settle; flags resume their gentle motion while the men recede into the courtyard.

beats.label: 高处留白
beats.detail: Hold a quiet wide ending, two small grounded figures beneath the dusk mountains; flags and leaves move gently, no new action or on-screen text.

beats.label: 单一机位
beats.detail: One continuous crane rising backward ends still on the whole courtyard, fixed focal length; one continuous shot, no cut.

board.prompt:
Create ONE cinematic storyboard still, 16:9, premium painterly 3D Chinese wuxia animated feature, not a photo. Reference 1 = white keeper identity and clothing ONLY; reference 2 = teal challenger identity and clothing ONLY; reference 3 = courtyard architecture, materials and dusk palette ONLY, not its camera or exact staircase count. Exactly two adult men except when specified offscreen. One plain straight jian each, empty scabbards, no extra weapon. Same grey stone low dais, muted red flags, warm western rim light. No captions, text, panel layout or montage. High wide courtyard ending, camera southwest height 11m, 28mm facing northeast. Two small full-body swordsmen remain close on central low circular dais, both swords lowered, no fighting. North shallow stairs upper left-middle, bell tower northeast upper right, big tree southeast right, broken west colonnade left. Mountain horizon visible, dusk and sparse red flags. Camera sees the same 24 by 22 metre courtyard from above, not a new temple. Freeze final 5.5 seconds.
CRITICAL: preserve final staggered pose, NOT a reset to face-to-face duel. Teal challenger stands foreground LEFT of white keeper, faces toward lower LEFT of picture (south), shoulders relaxed. White keeper stands 0.8m behind/right, faces diagonally toward challengers back, right sword withdrawn and lowered. Neither turns to face the other again or changes feet. The two figures are CLOSE and STAGGERED, both near CENTER of dais. Camera genuinely HIGH at 11m, sees top surfaces of all structures, not eye-level foreground closeup. Northern temple upper left, bell tower upper right, tree far right. Exactly eight shallow temple stair risers. Do not swap their screen order.
Spatial correction takes priority over the environment reference composition. Preserve illustrated cinematic quality. Draw a fresh composition from the specified side.
